sentences.text: Shri Vivek Agrawal - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri A.N. Gupta - Government Advocate for the responden
Heard on I.A. No.8190/2025, which is second application filed under Section 389(I) of Cr.P.C., on behalf of appellant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

Appellant has been convicted under Section 376(JH)(RH) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 12 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- and Section 5(THH) read with Section 6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 12 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- respectively, with default stipulations.
His earlier application was dismissed on merits vide order dated 24.10.2018.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the trial Court has wrongly convicted and sentenced the appellant.
The allegation against the appellant is of rape and he has already undergone above 9 years of incarceration.
Appellant has no previous criminal history.
He also submits that this appeal is of the year 2017 and would take time to be heard finally and as such, it is prayed that suspending the sentence awarded to appellant, he may be enlarged on bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer of 2 CRA-6325-2017 bail.
Heard the submissions made by counsel for parties and perused the record.
Though, the case of the prosecution is of rape committed by the appellant but perusal of medical report clearly states that there is old rupture in the private part of the victim.
Hence, theory of rape is full of ambiguity, therefore, we are inclined to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the remaining jail sentence awarded to appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail subject to his depositing the amount of fine, if not already deposited, and on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a surety bond of like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for her appearance before the Registry of this Court on 16.12.2025 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard.

Accordingly, the aforesaid I.A. is allowed and disposed of.
